# Set Orientation Lock

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the state of the devices Orientation Lock.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setOrientationLock(state: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setOrientationLock(state: true)
~~~~
